[Materials from the workshop and its presenters]{.eyebrow}

The workshop exists so people go home with something useful. This page is where the useful things live: white papers and publications that come out of the workshop, presenters' slides and handouts, and readings that presenters want the room to have.

**Presenters:** to share materials here, email them (or a link) to [sd33@txstate.edu](mailto:sd33@txstate.edu).
